0.original: Chambui is in need of meat.

24.original: Slay steppe dzos and obtain their meat.

26.original: Deliver the chunks of steppe dzo meat to Chambui's husband.

48.original: Fancy doing some hunting for me?

49.original: I have been so busy trading today that I have had no time to go hunting. Which is an issue as I am nearly out of buuz ingredients.

50.original: I would like you to slay four steppe dzos for me and bring back their meat. You should be able to find some just outside of Reunion.

52.original: We are far too busy today. I am struggling to keep up.

54.original: We Dazkar are somewhat different to the other tribes in that all our hunting is done by our women. My little girls are already proving to be quite skilled with a bow and arrow.

55.original: I am sorry to take even more of your time, but could you deliver the dzo meat to my husband? You will find him just behind that nearby tent.

57.original: Why, hello! Can I help you with something?

58.original: Ah, you have been hunting for my wife have you? You have my thanks.

59.original: I must say it is quite nice to have the chance to speak with someone that does not belong to my tribe!

60.original: I would love to talk more, but it is really time I got back to cooking. Speak with my wife and I am sure she will see you are rewarded for your hard work.

61.original: I would love to talk more, but I really need to focus on cooking. Speak with my wife and I am sure she will see you are rewarded for your hard work.

62.original: You may not be aware of this, but those from outside our tribe seldom have the chance to speak with Dazkar men.

63.original: Usually we keep our men at home, but my husband's buuz are so much better than anything I could make. I felt I would be depriving my customers if I did not give them the opportunity to sample his cooking.

64.original: Regardless, it is time I got back to work. Thank you for all you have done.
